import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv", parse_dates=["created"])
ok = d[d["actual_min"].between(1, 299)].copy()
ok["hour"] = ok["created"].dt.hour
y = ok["actual_min"]
X = pd.get_dummies(ok[["distance_km", "items", "promised_min", "hour", "courier", "weather", "shop_id"]], dtype=int)
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42)
pred = LinearRegression().fit(X_train, y_train).predict(X_test)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 5))
order = list(range(len(pred)-1,-1,-1))
cut = len(order)//2
for idx in (order[:cut],order[cut:]):
    ax.scatter(pred[idx],y_test.iloc[idx],s=8,alpha=.5)
ax.plot([10, 100], [10, 100], color="grey", linestyle="--")
ax.set_xlabel("прогноз, мин")
ax.set_ylabel("факт, мин")
ax.set_title("Линейная регрессия: факт против прогноза")
diagnostic: {"expected_pairs": [[float(x),float(y)] for x,y in zip(pred,y_test)], "scatter_offsets": [c.get_offsets().tolist() for c in ax.collections], "marker_pairs": [[[float(x),float(y)] for x,y in zip(l.get_xdata(),l.get_ydata())] for l in ax.lines if l.get_marker() not in (None,"None",""," ")]}
